from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfitMetric(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial metric for one company relevant to the profit categorization task."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company filing the report")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The time period covered by the financial report")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item label used in the document (e.g. 'Net Income', 'Net Loss')")
    net_profit_value: float | None = Field(description="The signed numeric value of the profit/loss metric; losses should be negative")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The magnitude scale of the reported number (e.g. 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the metric and value for grounding")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    profit_metrics: list[CompanyProfitMetric]
